datasets.title: Bank Directory
datasets.summary: Directory of all FDIC-insured banks with identity + headline figures.

datasets.title: Bank Snapshot
datasets.summary: Latest filed-quarter snapshot for one bank: balance sheet, capital, ratios.

datasets.title: Bank Trends
datasets.summary: Quarterly time series of key metrics for one bank.

datasets.title: HMDA Mortgage-Lending Book
datasets.summary: Per-bank Home Mortgage Disclosure Act book - applications, originations, denials, and USD volumes by activity year and state.

datasets.title: FDIC Bank Demographics
datasets.summary: FDIC institution demographics for one bank - CBSA/metro-micro classification, minority-status designation, head-office latitude/longitude, web URL, and office-count rollups, by as-of quarter.

datasets.title: FDIC SDI Financials
datasets.summary: FDIC Statistics on Depository Institutions (SDI) canonical financial series for one bank - quarterly balance sheet, income, capital, asset-quality, and efficiency metrics, newest period first.

datasets.title: UBPR Ratios
datasets.summary: Per-bank Uniform Bank Performance Report (UBPR) ratios - ~30 headline profitability, margin, efficiency, capital, asset-quality, and liquidity ratios per filed quarter (recent quarters only).

datasets.title: UBPR Peer-Percentile Ranks
datasets.summary: Per-bank UBPR percentile ranks within the bank's peer group, by report quarter and MDRM metric code.

datasets.title: Bank Scorecard
datasets.summary: CAMELS-style component scores (0–100) + overall letter grade.

datasets.title: Peer Percentile Ranks
datasets.summary: Pre-computed percentile rank within the bank's asset-size cohort.

datasets.title: Peer Set
datasets.summary: The peer set for one bank.

datasets.title: Peer Comparison
datasets.summary: One bank versus its peer-group benchmarks (5-number summary).

datasets.title: Branch Network
datasets.summary: FDIC Summary-of-Deposits branches + NIC org-structure branches.

datasets.title: Bank Deep Dive
datasets.summary: Full Call Report / UBPR detail for one bank-quarter.

datasets.title: Bank Corporate Structure, Full Hierarchy
datasets.summary: Full ownership hierarchy for one bank: parent(s), subsidiaries, and NIC merger/transformation history.

datasets.title: Bank Loan Portfolio
datasets.summary: Single-bank loan composition, CRE/C&D concentration vs capital, and an asset-quality trend.

datasets.title: Bank Scorecard, Full Composite
datasets.summary: CAMELS category metrics with quartile letter grades, a composite grade, loan-concentration context, and ML risk tier.

datasets.title: Bank Deposit Composition

datasets.title: Bank Securities Portfolio
